card.name: Punctuation in crop handling lists
card.fires_on: Commas and linking words inside lists of produce or crop handling steps, such as grading, sorting, sizing, packing. Also fires on a few other agricultural text spots.

modes.label: Commas in step lists
modes.description: A comma or 'and' between steps of produce packing or grading.
modes.example: Grading, sorting, sizing<<,>> packing, and palletizing are carried out

modes.label: Other crop text
modes.description: A comma after an adjective before a crop noun, or a word starting a new sentence or table cell in farming text.
modes.example: Always purchase good-size<<,>> healthy bulbs from a reputable dealer.

card.plain: It marks commas and linking words in farming text about handling and packing produce.
